# itemVisualizationArgumentTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [itemVisualizationArgumentTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/itemVisualizationArgumentTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The visualization of an item is given as its VItem class, or as a dict with only the parameters that differ
#           from the defaults (#2342); a parameter the item does not have is refused. The result is the number of
#           checks that pass plus the end position of the body drawn with the dict.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-09
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See "LICENSE.txt" for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import *
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
from exudyn import cMath

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)
SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()
checks = []

#a dict with one parameter: the others keep their defaults
boxGraphics = [graphics.Brick(size=[0.2, 0.2, 0.2], color=graphics.color.dodgerblue)]
node = mbs.AddNode(NodePoint(referenceCoordinates=[0, 1, 0]))
massPoint = MassPoint(mass=1., nodeNumber=node, visualization={'graphicsData': boxGraphics})
checks += [isinstance(massPoint.visualization, VMassPoint) and massPoint.visualization.show]
body = mbs.AddObject(massPoint)
checks += [mbs.GetObject(body)['Vshow'] and len(mbs.GetObject(body)['VgraphicsData']) == 1]

#the default and the class
checks += [isinstance(ObjectGround().visualization, VObjectGround)]
oGround = mbs.AddObject(ObjectGround(visualization=VObjectGround(show=False)))
checks += [not mbs.GetObject(oGround)['Vshow']]

#a dict for a connector, with a parameter of a list type
marker0 = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyPosition(bodyNumber=oGround, localPosition=[0, 0, 0]))
marker1 = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodePosition(nodeNumber=node))
color = [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 1.]
spring = mbs.AddObject(SpringDamper(markerNumbers=[marker0, marker1], stiffness=100., referenceLength=1.,
                                    visualization={'color': color}))
checks += [mbs.GetObject(spring)['Vshow'] and abs(mbs.GetObject(spring)['Vcolor'][1] - 0.3) < 1e-6]

#defaults are not shared between items
item0 = ObjectGround(visualization={'graphicsData': boxGraphics})
item1 = ObjectGround()
item0.visualization.graphicsData.append(boxGraphics[0])
checks += [len(item1.visualization.graphicsData) == 0 and len(boxGraphics) == 1]

#a parameter which the item does not have
try:
    ObjectGround(visualization={'colour': color})
    checks += [False]
except ValueError as error:
    checks += ['ObjectGround' in str(error) and 'colour' in str(error)]

mbs.Assemble()
simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 100
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.5
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False
mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)

if not testIsActive:
    mbs.SolutionViewer(simulationSettings)

y = mbs.GetNodeOutput(node, exu.OutputVariableType.Position)[1]
u = sum(checks) + y
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of itemVisualizationArgumentTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
